acceptance_criteria: Traces to its accepted system and software anchors and is verified by its named checks, documentation route, or report inspection.
statement: The task-owned documentation checker shall fail closed, exiting nonzero, when an owned public declaration is undocumented, a mandatory contract tag is absent, or the strict generation emits a warning; it shall exit zero only for a complete, warning-free result.
title: Fail-closed documentation checker
